content.text: In regions where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-minimum-viable-stack-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant barriers to launching online stores. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela experience restrictions that hinder financial transactions, forcing creators to seek alternative solutions. COREMERCH offers a robust infrastructure that empowers digital creators to set up their own stores using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-15|Cloudflare R2]] Pages, eliminating reliance on platforms that restrict access to financial tools. This guide will walk you through how to deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, ensuring you can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-10|crypto]] payments seamlessly.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Conventional platforms often impose geographic restrictions that limit access for digital creators in various countries. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to circumvent these barriers by leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages, which is accessible globally. This architecture ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their data and products without the risk of being locked out from payment processing. By using NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, bypassing the traditional banking system that often excludes them.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts set up. You'll need a GitHub account to host your site on GitHub Pages, a Cloudflare account for managing your domain and settings, and a NOWPayments account for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will be essential for backend logic. Prepare your digital products, including eBooks, courses, or templates, ensuring they are ready for upload. With these elements in place, you can proceed confidently to deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying Stack 01, which includes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for your store's backend. Configure NOWPayments to handle crypto payments efficiently. Set up your product delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. This setup enables automatic delivery once a payment is confirmed. You'll also write a script in Google Apps to manage order processing and notifications. Testing this pipeline is crucial; ensure all components communicate effectively to provide a seamless experience for your customers.
Full ownership of your data means no lock-in with third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery systems are set up, it's time to go live. Publish your GitHub Pages site and ensure all links and functionalities work correctly. Conduct a test transaction using a cryptocurrency wallet to confirm that your payment processing works as intended. Once validated, promote your store through social media and other channels, directing potential customers to your site. Monitor the transaction process closely, addressing any issues that may arise to ensure a smooth experience for your buyers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, consider expanding your offerings. Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, allows you to host more products and enhances your infrastructure with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase for order management. As your store grows, utilize the scaling playbook included in the Sovereign Blueprint to optimize your operations. Focus on marketing your store and engaging with your audience to drive more traffic and sales, ensuring you maximize the potential of your newly established digital commerce environment.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by setting up a GitHub account for hosting. Deploy your store using Cloudflare Pages and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This architecture allows total control over your data while facilitating seamless crypto transactions without relying on conventional payment platforms.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of just 0.5%.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting on GitHub Pages. Set up a Cloudflare account to manage your site settings. Sign up for NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency payments. Prepare your digital products for upload. Deploy Stack 01 by configuring GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Set up automated product delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Conduct thorough testing of the payment and delivery pipeline. Go live and promote your digital store through various channels.
